title: Every software market verdict — Do Not Build
excerpt: Build, caution or avoid — the standing verdict on every software market this tool has screened with real money.
content_html:
250 software markets screened across 6 countries, each with real money against paid data sources, each ending in one of three words. The avoids and cautions are free to read by name. A build's name — and the evidence every verdict rests on: who already serves the need, what a customer costs, which barriers held — is what an account is for.

Screening one of these cost dollars. Reading why any verdict came out the way it did costs an account — three markets a month of it are free.
